about: Shrinking list. These avoid-word hits existed when the glossary check was introduced (16 November 2026). The check fails on any hit not listed here, and on any listed hit that no longer exists: remove or lower an entry in the same commit that fixes it. Never add an entry. When the list is empty, delete this file and the check is absolute.

hits.text: - The qualification table (section 10) stays empty either way:
- `qualification` names the qualification row, or `fixture:<label>` when a
State is not in installedAddons, or its descriptor was not created by contractFor.stateAddon.
State requires the descriptor created by contractFor.stateAddon.
